items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday due to a calf injury and was listed as limited. Already without Davante Adams (hamstring, 6-10 weeks).
items.why: Left practice early; listed limited on report.
items.implication: Status for Week 7 vs LV in doubt; further reduces Rams WR depth.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes to TEs (Higbee) and remaining WRs if OUT; reverse prior Puka volume spike.

items.text: Multiple teams open to potential trade for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor; unclear if Colts ready to unload before deadline.
items.implication: ROS uncertainty; monitor deadline for landing spot/usage change.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup value in IND rises if moved.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially DNP for second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Elevated risk of missing or limited Week 7; monitor Friday report.
items.opportunity: Potential bump to Xavier Worthy and other KC pass-catchers if inactive.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice (Jets injury report).
items.opportunity: Potential full role return; reverse backups.

items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP list, a significant move. Full practices; expected to debut Week 7 vs KC.
items.why: Activated after full practices post-ACL; significant for backfield.
items.implication: Muddies SEA RB committee; likely goal-line/short-yardage role; sinks current backups' value.
items.opportunity: Charbonnet flex/TD upside long-term; reverse Wilson/Price beneficiaries.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in team meetings, lifting, medical at facility (non-football). MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers; OL mess. Long-term outlook discussed on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Facility access positive; backups poor EPA.
items.implication: Jacobs return imminent/positive ROS; fade Lloyd/Johnson.
items.opportunity: Jacobs workload rebound; backups not viable.

items.text: Lamar Jackson present for start of Thursday’s practice (after no sign Wednesday).
items.opportunity: QB1 if clears; Ravens offense boost.

items.text: Saquon Barkley 'in line' to play vs DAL Monday (RB15 rank); efficient in full games played; DAL strong RB matchup.
Terrance Ferguson (IR eligible next week) not expected ready; recovery 'will take some time'. Was biggest Adams beneficiary; now Rams answer is 25 Puka Nacua targets/game.
items.why: Ferguson delay leaves Puka as primary.
items.implication: Massive target share for healthy Puka.
items.opportunity: Puka WR1 lock if active; TE/RB spillover limited.
items.conflict: Conflicts with subsequent calf injury limiting Puka.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role, elite volume potential vs Bears secondary allowing yardage.
Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11): elite volume, friendly matchup.
Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6), Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12): big workloads/friendly matchups (Lions D gift to pass-catchers; RB-friendly spots).
Hates Rome Odunze vs NE, Josh Downs @ MIN, Travis Kelce @ SEA, Josh Jacobs @ DET, Cam Skattebo @ HOU: nasty matchups, role/workload questions (Jacobs post-layoff), target-share issues.
items.conflict: Jacobs facility access positive per Levitan.

items.text: Thorman Snaps & Pace Week 7: Up in pace TB@CAR, GB@DET, LAR@LV. Slow slogs MIA@NYJ, SF@ATL, IND@MIN. High volume/explosive potential in up games.
items.implication: Prefer skill players in high-pace games for volume.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes/carries in TB/CAR, GB/DET, LAR/LV.
